view_type: overview research board with applied display strip
caption: University discipline competition board for Culture China cultural tourism research, teal header with large Chinese research title, subtle illustrated Tianjin city background, project explanation block, extracted color palette swatches, four modular illustrated information-visualization panels about river transport, culture, city aesthetics and value analysis, plus a bottom application display strip with phone cases, booklets, posters, transit media and exhibition scenarios.
positive_aesthetic_notes: strong separation between research title, project explanation, infovis panels and application display
teal academic header creates a consistent non-commercial competition identity
hand-drawn cultural tourism illustrations give regional warmth without losing board order
color extraction swatches are treated as evidence, not decorative stickers
negative_failure_notes: do not copy or generate the large diagonal watermark as a design element
avoid turning dense illustrated sub-panels into uncontrolled clutter
do not treat this as a commercial campaign poster or product advertisement
text_accuracy_notes: The main Chinese research title may be referenced when the source text is supplied; dense paragraph copy, small labels, and watermark text should be treated as layout signals only.
layout_notes: Top teal research header, mid-section four-panel evidence grid, bottom application proof strip; rounded section tags and ship icons repeat as navigation markers.

view_type: web interaction and application flow board
caption: Culture China competition board showing an interactive cultural tourism website system, teal research header, rounded white content container, left homepage and e-commerce page screenshots, central one-click coloring interaction sequence and about-us page, right page-jump examples with tablet overlay mockups, dark red website navigation bars, dense screenshot grid, and repeated ship-shaped section labels.
positive_aesthetic_notes: useful example of presenting UI and web interaction evidence inside a competition board
screens are grouped by interaction task rather than scattered randomly
teal frame and dark red web chrome distinguish academic research board from commercial landing page
device overlays explain application flow without becoming the main aesthetic
negative_failure_notes: do not reproduce the diagonal watermark
avoid overfitting the exact website screenshots as final UI requirements
do not compress too many screens without visible grouping labels and margins
text_accuracy_notes: Use headings such as website homepage, one-click coloring, about us, and page jump as structural references; exact UI copy and screenshot text require source files.
layout_notes: Header describes the research topic; white rounded board contains three-column web evidence: homepage/shop on left, interaction sequence in center, page jumps on right.

caption: Detailed Culture China cultural tourism information-visualization board with teal background, large rounded white panel, dashed modular boxes, hand-drawn river system map, canal development timeline, transportation goods icons, famous check-in landmarks, food route diagram, flower illustration module, and two large inset infographic pages with soft drop shadows.
positive_aesthetic_notes: strong transfer value for cultural tourism maps, timeline modules, icon inventories and illustrated city knowledge
dashed boxes organize high information density into readable academic modules
hand-drawn regional illustrations and clean infographic labels balance warmth with research logic
large inset boards show how detailed infovis pages can be nested without losing hierarchy
negative_failure_notes: do not let small labels become garbled pseudo-Chinese
avoid decorative map icons unless tied to an information category
do not turn all modules into equal visual weight; keep primary inset boards dominant
text_accuracy_notes: Dense Chinese labels, food names, route nodes, and map names must be sourced for exact generation; otherwise use placeholder label blocks with correct hierarchy.
layout_notes: Left column contains small research modules; right side carries two large infovis page insets; bottom row organizes landmarks, food and flowers into dashed modules.
